_readme: DEFCON / non-attacking midfielders whose points come from defensive contributions and set-pieces, NOT open-play attack · so they are uncorrelated with a team's attacking output. The optimiser's 'max 1 attacker per club' rule exempts these, which is why a same-club pair like Garner + Ndiaye (defcon + pens) is allowed. Keyed by FPL player code. Edit freely.
